descriptions.w3d_d21e_register_camera_view_properties: Registers Camera2ObjectDistance (0x801ec52c); registers LookSpeed (0x801ec52c); registers UpSpeed (0x801ec52c); registers ZoomSpeed (0x801ec52c); registers MinPreferredDistance (0x801ec52c); registers MinPosition (0x801ec52c); registers MinTimeBetweenCuts (0x801ebf38); registers ViewPoint (0x801f254c) with a guarded function-local static descriptor built once from a zero-filled temporary; calls the refresh routine 0x801e8d9c and returns 0.
